name: zmodel_const_split_polygon_chunked_by_vertex_limit
description: zModel_Const::SplitPolygonChunkedByVertexLimit emits a triangle fan through zDi::AddPolygonEx while staging optional per-vertex attributes.
known_limits: This helper recursively calls zDi::AddPolygonEx. Functional acceptance is limited to the triangle-fan staging path covered by the native smoke; full tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482fe0 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx, totalVertexCount in edx, and points, entryNormals, uvPairsA, normalsA, normalsBInput, uvPairsBInput, material, drawFlags, flagBit8, and userTag on the stack.

Binary Ninja assembly validates the triangle fan anchored at vertex 0, staging vertices [0, i - 1, i], optional entry normals, secondary UVs when material flag 0x0100 is set, optional normalsB when normalsA is non-null, and recursive calls to zDi::AddPolygonEx with vertexCount 3.
The native smoke verifies a four-vertex polygon emits two triangle entries with expected point and UV staging through the production zDi::AddPolygonEx path.
